_comment: Captured 2026-09-10 against real hardware (luz 1, id ebfake1111111111111111, 192.168.1.6, protocol 3.5) via a tshark capture of a tinytuya BulbDevice.status() call. local_nonce was fixed to a known value via a temporary, reverted, venv-only patch to tinytuya's XenonDevice.py (commenting out its os.urandom(16) call) so both sides of the handshake are reproducible and diffable. remote_nonce and session_key_hex were independently re-derived and cross-checked (a) against tinytuya's own DEBUG log line for this exact session and (b) against a from-scratch Python reference implementation using the `cryptography` package before this Go code was written. frame_dpquery_resp_plaintext is the real decrypted device response, confirming the derived session key actually authenticates and decrypts genuine hardware-generated traffic (its IV is device-generated, not the fixed local_nonce-derived one).
